Bill.BriefDescription: Providing immunity for police horse handlers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to police horses; and amending RCW 4.24.410.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 4.24.410 and 1993 c 180 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) As used in this section: (a) "Police dog" means a dog used by a law enforcement agencyspecially trained for law enforcement work and under the control of adog handler. (b) "Accelerant detection dog" means a dog used exclusively foraccelerant detection by the state fire marshal or a fire department andunder the control of the state fire marshal or his or her designee ora fire department handler. (c) "Dog handler" means a law enforcement officer who hassuccessfully completed training as prescribed by the Washington statecriminal justice training commission in police dog handling, or in thecase of an accelerant detection dog, the state fire marshal's designeeor an employee of the fire department authorized by the fire chief tobe the dog's handler. p. 1 HB 2440 (d) "Horse handler" means a law enforcement officer who hassuccessfully completed training as prescribed by the Washington statecriminal justice training commission in police horse handling. (e) "Police horse" means a horse used by a law enforcement agencyspecially trained for law enforcement work and under the control of ahorse handler. (2) Any dog handler who uses a police dog and any horse handler whouses a police horse in the line of duty in good faith is immune fromcivil action for damages arising out of ((such)) the use of the policedog ((or)), accelerant detection dog, or police horse.
